model.expr: sum by(source_butler, destination_butler, reason) ((butlers_domain_event_delivery_failed_permanent_deliveries_total{job="butlers"} unless max_over_time(butlers_domain_event_delivery_failed_permanent_deliveries_total{job="butlers"}[1h] offset 15m)) or increase(butlers_domain_event_delivery_failed_permanent_deliveries_total{job="butlers"}[15m]))

annotations.description: A durable domain-event delivery transitioned to failed_permanent in the last 15 minutes.
annotations.no_data: The configured NoData policy takes effect only after an owner explicitly enables evaluation; it then keeps a missing series visible rather than treating it as healthy.
annotations.exec_error: The configured Error policy takes effect only after an owner explicitly enables evaluation; it then surfaces rule execution failures.
annotations.reset: increase() treats an exporter counter reset as zero rather than a new delivery failure.
annotations.first_event: A route series is created by its first failure, so increase() has no prior sample to compare. For 15 minutes a series with no sample in the hour before that also counts with its own value. Ingest gaps shorter than 1h therefore cannot replay old failures. Trade-off: after a daemon restart, increase() misses the first failure on a route whose last sample was 20 to 75 minutes earlier. The series is not pre-created at zero because two daemons (butlers up and the Switchboard) emit identical label sets, and the zeros of one would interleave with the other's count.
annotations.deduplication: The query preserves source_butler, destination_butler, and reason; Grafana creates one alert instance per label tuple.
annotations.disabled: isPaused=true: Grafana performs no evaluation and creates no alert instances, receiver, notification policy, or route.
